title: As a Spec Builder maintainer, I want packaged samples to match the current schemas so that seeded artifacts are trustworthy examples.
description: Represent the maintainer need for packaged sample assets that reflect current artifact structures, document expectations, and cross-linking patterns.
goal: packaged samples to match the current schemas
acceptance_criteria: Given a packaged sample JSON file, when a maintainer opens it, then the file uses current type names and includes realistic metadata.
Given a packaged sample markdown file, when a maintainer reads it, then it contains representative sections instead of placeholder text.
Given linked sample artifacts, when downstream renderers resolve relationships, then ids and paths remain internally consistent.
